_comment: Draconic Illusionist Token - Ash. '**Material** - While Ash is under an object, that object has **phantasm**.' Granted when the Ash is put underneath (CR 8.5.36a). The printed wording is CONTINUOUS, so removing the Ash afterwards should remove phantasm and currently does not -- there is no continuous layer keyed on sub-cards. Stated here rather than left to be discovered.
